test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 12 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six persons – A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing away from the centre. B sits immediate left of A. F is sitting immediate right to A. E is sitting immediately adjacent to F and D. C is sitting immediate right to D. Who among the following is sitting immediately adjacent to A and C?
solution:
Given: Six persons – A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing away from the centre.

1) B sits immediate left of A.

2) F is sitting immediate right to A.

3) E is sitting immediately adjacent to F and D.

4) C is sitting immediate right to D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04dcc9ef2a5a47e6b63dfd9f741d29ee84e4b9695a34737a3d6196d601d72bf4.png] 

Here, 'B' is sitting immediately adjacent to A and C.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
